people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”
translations.bsb: Then Jonathan gave his equipment to the boy and said, “Go, take it back to the city.”
translations.kjv: And Jonathan gave his artillery unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
translations.asv: And Jonathan gave his weapons unto his lad, and said unto him, Go, carry them to the city.
